description: This file defines the TpTimer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It implements a timer with start, stop, and callback functionalities, including internal class TpTimerJob for managing timer jobs. The class interacts with an underlying core timer type and provides mechanisms for single-shot or recurring timer operations.

classes.name: TpTimer
classes.description: A timer class that manages scheduling and execution of timed callbacks, supporting start, stop, and interval configuration.

classes.name: TpTimerJob
classes.description: An internal class representing a timer job, which invokes the parent TpTimer's Timed() method when scheduled.

methods.name: TpTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default parameters.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes scheduled jobs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the previously set interval.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Configures the timer to run only once if set to true.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be invoked on timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method called when the timer expires; invokes the callback and manages recurring behavior.
